answers:
1. I don't have a specific story about what we left out or refused to give up in the 400 sq ft, so I'd skip that one. I just know it was tight and we had to be picky.

2. Yes, the very first book we sold was a copy of Middlemarch, and the guy who bought it, Mr. Okafor, still comes in every week. I'd love to use that.

3. I don't remember the details of how we grew into the second floor, so I'd rather not guess. Let's leave that out and just say we have two floors now.

4. Kind of, yeah. That Middlemarch going to Mr. Okafor is the one I'd use, and he's still a regular, so it's a nice full-circle thing. I don't have a story about someone telling me a book is still on their shelf.

5. I know the party is October 25, but I don't have the time or the program decided, so I'd leave those out for now. For memories, I haven't picked a way yet, so replying to the thread is probably simplest.

The Tidewater Bookshop turns 10 this month. We opened in 400 sq ft. Now we have two floors of books.

3/5
The very first book we sold was a copy of Middlemarch. The man who bought it, Mr. Okafor, still comes in every week.

4/5
Thank you to everyone who has bought a book, recommended us to a friend, or stopped in to browse over the past decade. Those visits helped us get here.

5/5
Our anniversary party is October 25. Come celebrate with us.

If you remember the 400 sq ft days, reply to this thread with your memories. We'd love to hear them.
